# GoHighLevel (HighLevel)
> HighLevel is an AI-powered, all-in-one sales and marketing platform built for marketing agencies, freelancers, and business owners. It consolidates CRM, funnels, email/SMS marketing, booking, reputation management, workflow automation, and white-label reselling into a single platform. Plans start at $97/month with a 14-day free trial.
Use this file to find authoritative pages covering HighLevel's product features, pricing, comparisons, company information, developer resources, and policies.
## Product & Platform
- [Home](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Overview of the AI-powered business operating system — capture, nurture, close, and reactivate leads.
- [Pricing](https://www.gohighlevel.com/pricing): Plan details — Starter ($97/mo, 3 sub-accounts) and Unlimited ($297/mo, unlimited sub-accounts), with feature breakdown and trial CTA.
- [Features – CRM & Pipeline Management](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Contacts, pipelines, lead scoring, and sales tracking.
- [Features – Website, Funnels & Landing Pages](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Drag-and-drop builder for websites, sales funnels, and landing pages.
- [Features – Email Marketing](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Broadcast campaigns, newsletter automation, and Content AI.
- [Features – SMS Marketing](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Two-way SMS, ringless voicemail, and missed-call text-back.
- [Features – Booking & Appointments](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Calendar scheduling, paid calendars, and appointment reminders.
- [Features – Workflow Automations](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Visual automation builder for follow-up sequences, triggers, and multi-channel campaigns.
- [Features – Reputation Management](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Automated review requests, AI review replies, and review widgets.
- [Features – Payments & E-Commerce](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Invoicing, order forms, upsells, Text-2-Pay, Tap-2-Pay, gift cards, and loyalty programs.
- [Features – Communities](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Member community tools for agencies and course creators.
- [Features – AI Voice & Conversation AI](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Voice AI for inbound/outbound calls; Conversation AI for chat widgets and consolidated messaging (SMS, Messenger, Instagram DM, WhatsApp, Live Chat).
- [Features – Social Planner & Ad Manager](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): Social media scheduling and Google/Facebook/Instagram ad management.
- [Mobile App](https://www.gohighlevel.com/): iOS and Android app for managing contacts, conversations, and pipelines on the go.

Frequently asked questions
Is there a long-term contract?
No. HighLevel operates on a month-to-month basis. There are no long-term contracts, and you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your account at any time directly from your dashboard.
Does HighLevel replace other tools I’m using?
Yes! HighLevel is an all-in-one platform designed to replace multiple subscriptions you're probably paying for now. Most users replace their CRM, funnel builder, email marketing software, appointment scheduler, SMS marketing tools, and review management software just to name a few. Consolidating these into HighLevel often saves agencies hundreds if not thousands of dollars per month.
Is there a free trial?
Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial. You get full access to the features of your chosen tier so you can set up your account, build funnels, and test automations before you pay a dime.
Do I need to be tech-savvy to use HighLevel?
No! While HighLevel is a powerful enterprise-grade tool, it is built with usability in mind. We provide extensive support (especially when you're just getting started), a "Snapshot" library of pre-built accounts for various industries (like Real Estate, Dentists and Gyms), and a massive community of users to help you get started quickly without any technical knowledge.
What is the main difference between the Starter and Unlimited plans?
The primary difference is the number of "Sub-Accounts" you can manage. The Agency Starter ($97/mo) includes 3 Sub-Accounts, making it perfect for a single business owner or a new agency. The Agency Unlimited ($297/mo) includes unlimited Sub-Accounts, allowing you to scale your agency and add as many clients as you want without your software costs increasing.
What is "SaaS Mode" on the Pro Plan ($497/mo)?
SaaS Mode transforms HighLevel into your own sellable software product. It allows you to sell subscriptions directly from your website, automatically creating client accounts without any manual work from you. You set the price, the system handles the setup, and you earn additional recurring revenue by automatically rebilling for SMS, email usage, and other popular features like WordPress hosting.
What does "Unlimited" actually cover?
On all plans, you get unlimited contacts and unlimited users (team members). On the Agency Starter plan, you are limited to 3 Sub-Accounts. On the Unlimited and Pro plans, you also get unlimited Sub-Accounts.
Can I use my own domain and branding?
Yes. You can connect custom domains for all your funnels and websites. Plus, you have the ability to white-label the desktop web app, meaning your clients see your logo and branding when they log in, not HighLevel's.
Are there any hidden fees?
Your subscription covers the platform features, but there are usage-based costs for telecommunications and AI services, which are standard across the industry. This includes charges for phone numbers, SMS (text messaging), emails sent, and premium AI usage. On the Unlimited and Pro plans, you can "rebill" these costs to your clients, often adding a markup to create your own profit.
Can I switch plans later?
Absolutely! You can upgrade from Starter to Unlimited (or Pro) as you sign more clients. If you upgrade mid-month, you will only be charged the prorated difference. You can also downgrade if your needs change.
Disclaimer
: HighLevel provides software-based automation and AI-powered tools designed to help support business workflows. AI features are software functionality only, require setup, configuration, and ongoing human oversight. Results, performance, cost savings, and efficiencies vary based on use case, configuration, and business practices. References to “AI Employee,” “automation,” or “unlimited” features describe platform functionality and access only.
Billing begins automatically at the end of any free trial unless canceled, and usage-based fees for telecommunications or third-party services may apply during the trial. Nothing on this page should be construed as a promise of earnings, cost savings, or business results.
